g.text: Each compiled final plays 6 maps × 4 fixed opponents × 2 seats = 48 correlated games. Invalid authorship stays zero; missing draws block reporting.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Uncertainty resamples 16 paired authoring trajectories, including invalid draws. One training seed; turns and individual games are not independent.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Both endpoints use native-low draft thinking, the same practice feedback, then a native-nonthinking code revision. No new SFT or RL occurs here.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: Two evaluation teachers were prior SFT examples. This closes only the three-update comparison; it does not complete the abandoned longer study.
